neighbours.label: The golden calf story at Sinai: the calf, the idol, and the digit in 'Exodus 32'; other Moses stories and other calves stay low.
fire: While Moses was on the mountain, they danced around a golden calf.
The sin of the golden calf, told in Exodus 32, angered God.
Aaron collected their gold and cast the calf with a tool.
Moses saw the calf and threw the stone tablets down.
Exodus 32:19 describes the anger of Moses at the idol.
The rabbis asked why Israel worshipped the calf so soon after Sinai.
They bowed before the molten calf and offered sacrifices to it.
Read Exodus 32 for the story of Aaron and the idol of gold.
quiet: While Moses was on the mountain, they waited at the camp below.
The story of the burning bush, told in Exodus 3, moved him.
Aaron collected their tents and led the people with a staff.
Moses saw the river and led the children across.
Exodus 16:4 describes the bread that fell from heaven.
The rabbis asked why Israel wandered for forty years after Sinai.
They milked the young calf and fed the chickens in the yard.
Read Genesis 12 for the story of Abraham and the land of promise.
